# Jupiter Laser & Regenerative Medicine

> Advanced foot and ankle care in Jupiter, Florida: FDA-cleared MLS laser therapy, shockwave therapy (EPAT), platelet-rich plasma (PRP), and regenerative cell treatments, led by board-certified foot and ankle surgeon Dr. Orlando Cedeno, DPM. An Abacoa Podiatry & Leg Vein Center practice.

Key facts:
- Address: 4601 Military Trail, Suite 202, Jupiter, FL 33458
- Phone: (561) 624-4800
- Hours: Monday-Friday 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM
- Physician: Dr. Orlando Cedeno, DPM — board-certified foot & ankle surgeon; Barry University School of Podiatric Medicine & Surgery; surgical residency in reconstructive and trauma surgery at Chestnut Hill Hospital/University of Pennsylvania
- Service area: Jupiter, Palm Beach Gardens, Tequesta, Juno Beach, North Palm Beach, Hobe Sound, Stuart, and the northern Palm Beaches
- Signature treatment: MLS (Multiwave Locked System) laser therapy — FDA-cleared, painless, 10-15 minute sessions, typical course 6-12 sessions

## Services
- [MLS Laser Therapy](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/mls-laser-therapy/): dual-wavelength (808 nm + 905 nm) laser for pain, inflammation, and tissue healing
- [Shockwave Therapy (EPAT)](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/shockwave-therapy/): acoustic wave treatment for chronic plantar fasciitis and tendinopathy
- [Stem Cell Therapy](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/stem-cell-therapy/): regenerative cell treatment for tendons, ligaments, and joints
- [PRP Therapy](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/prp-therapy/): platelet-rich plasma injections from the patient's own blood
- [Regenerative Medicine Programs](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/regenerative-medicine/): combined staged treatment plans
